title: Agricultural Tower
description: An entity that seeds and harvests plants automatically.

enable_harvesting_condition.title: Enable Harvesting Condition
enable_harvesting_condition.description: Whether or not this entity should conditionally enable/disable harvesting.

harvesting_condition.title: Harvesting Condition
harvesting_condition.description: The condition that must pass in order for this tower to harvest mature crops.

enable_planting_condition.title: Enable Planting Condition
enable_planting_condition.description: Whether or not this entity should conditionally enable/disable planting.

planting_condition.title: Planting Condition
planting_condition.description: The condition that must pass in order for this tower to plant additional seeds.

read_contents.title: Read Contents
read_contents.description: Whether or not this entity should broadcast the contents of its inventory to a connected circuit network.
